game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass, a pass in a sandstorm: the caravan guide must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Algorithm Race: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass: a pass in a sandstorm
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstorm Pass, repeat each round: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the speed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the sundial using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the sundial is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 5 (applied tier): Algorithm Race
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Algorithm Race' (Week 9 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sandstorm Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how speed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Sandstorm Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The sundial reached with actions_used <= 12.
